description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable class 'ImmutableMappingContext' which models a mapping context with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and builder pattern. It is part of the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContext
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the MappingContext interface, representing a mapping configuration with engine, options, and conditions.

classes.name: ImmutableMappingContext.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ImmutableMappingContext instances, supporting method chaining.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableMappingContext instance from mapping engine string and options JSON object.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a MappingContext object from a JSON representation.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to a JSON object with optional schema version and predicate filtering.
